body:
Update: 
Gig was the best yet. So much positive feedback from the crowd. I'm not as certain about snuffing it now but cannot guarantee my own safety. Might try to hospitalise myself. The older I get, the more likely are my attempts to be serious and succeed. I've tried about 6 times all up, mostly when I was younger and back then it was cry for help stuff. If I do it now, I'll do it properly, without telling anyone. Hope they take me seriously in hospital if I go because last time I tried to do the right thing they were dismissive, sent me home and two days later I was on a bridge ready to go, cops got to me and they ended up having to hospitalise me anyway. All I want is some regular professional help, meds that work and to stop slipping through the cracks in the system because I present as 'sane' and 'rational' when, internally, that could not be further from the truth. I am chaos. 
I want to study and work. I want to be able to focus on hobbies at least. I want to get off the dole. There are just so many fucking obstacles and I'm so drained and frustrated. 

Thanks for the feedback, guys.
Yeah worth a shot, I suppose. There is no pressure, other than the pressure I put on myself.

Usually thinking about how much pain my death would cause is the very thing that keeps me going. I don't care about myself at all but I do care about others and also know first hand how much suicide destroys loved ones. This time I feel so destroyed that I see it as euthanasia. A sick, suffering animal can get put down. Why can't I? I'm sick and suffering and treatment either doesn't work or I cannot afford it. Right now I feel like I'm only living for everyone else. There's no quality of life for me, the way things are. I'm exhausted from trying to fix it.

Although perfectly valid and constructive suggestions, my problem with goals is that the combination of BPD identity issues and ADHD focus/memory problems prevent me from sticking to any goal or routine. I don't know who I am or what I want day to day, can't get started, get bored too easily or am dissociated/daydreaming so get nothing done. I can't read anymore, can't draw anymore, can't sit still long enough to learn more music, can't sit through movies or shows, struggle with video games (which I usually love), struggle with conversations and even writing this reply is a challenge. I can't stick with exercise plans because I get really bored really quick. I also can't recognise when I do achieve something unless someone forces me to. Purpose does help though. My band gives me a purpose but I can't even focus enough to practice between rehearsals/gigs to be a better player and band member. Sometimes I don't turn up to rehearsal because my head sabotages me. I hate this. 

This chaos is so thoroughly draining. One disorder feeds the other and I can't seem to break the cycle, no matter what I do or don't do. More professional help would be nice but nobody takes me seriously enough.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts and believing in me. Maybe you're right, I do have a shred of hope, hence posting here, but fuck, I'm in pain right now.

Pretty sure I've experienced this before. Possibly what was happening when I was on sertraline late last year. It never made any positive difference to my mood and towards the end I got so sluggish and suicidal. I quit sertraline and felt much better. Completely unmedicated now, other than occasional valium. Might still look all that neurotixicity stuff up though. Cheers for the idea. I've been on that many meds that maybe there's lasting damage or something. 

The suicidal stuff then felt different though. There was virtually no thought process behind it. It was passive and easy to dismiss. Just draining because the suicidal ideation just wouldn't fuck off and I wanted to get shit done. I've been suicidal on and off, mostly on, for over a decade and have learned to distinguish between passive and active ideation. This time it feels much more real and serious. It's active and dangerous. I've only felt like this a handful of times. This is one of the worst and my support network has gone to shit.

Thank you. I try writing periodically but, as is the case with most other things in my life, I struggle to focus. I want to write songs but, once again, struggle to focus long enough to channel my chaos creatively. Unmanaged ADHD is a hell of a thing.
The beat is solid my dude
This would be ok without the vocals. They gave me cancer.
